title: 俱乐部联盟 H2 会员首页状态分层后端修复
objective: replace the ambiguous member-home club status with independently sourced club_status and membership_status fields without promoting application or membership history into current clubs
verification: PASS: gofmt on both allowed Go files
PASS: backend git diff --check and allowed-path audit
PASS: changed-file sensitive-pattern scan returned zero matches
PENDING: controlled integration, deployment, and test-environment UAT
premises: club_members has no membership-state column; a present row is the current active relationship and leave removes that row, so this checkpoint emits membership_status=active only
suspended is not emitted because the backend has no authoritative suspended current-membership state
club lifecycle remains independent: a persisted dissolved club is returned as club_status=dissolved without writing dissolved into membership_status
pending and rejected join applications are read from a different entity and never enter the current member-home club query
verified covers repository implementation and Go gates only; no deployment, database migration, registry change, or environment mutation was authorized
